newsitem.title: USA: Jack Henry sets acquisition, sees gains.
newsitem.headline: Jack Henry sets acquisition, sees gains.

text.p: Jack Henry & Associates Inc, which sells computer software and hardware to community banks, said Thursday it had agreed to acquire GG Pulley & Associates Inc, an Albuquerque, N.M.-based provider of products and services to financial institutions.
Jack Henry said it expects GG Pulley to add $0.01 to $0.04 per share to its fiscal 1998 earnings, on revenues exceeding $6 million.
The $5 million stock transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, it said.
The transaction is expected to be closed within two to three weeks, it said in a news release.
GG Pulley was profitable with $6 million in revenue for the year ended December 31, 1996.
Jack Henry said the acquisition will enable it to sell item processing software outside its customer base and provide additional resources and expertise to further expand its current products.
Jack Henry provides integrated computer systems and ATM networking products for banks and other financial institutions.
